summary: Gerdau S.A. files Form 6-K to announce completion of a previously disclosed acquisition of a 23.03% equity stake in Dona Francisca Energética S.A. (DFESA) from Centrais Elétricas de Santa Catarina S.A. (CELESC). The enterprise value is R$150 million, with a total cash disbursement of approximately R$154 million including proportional cash, paid from own resources. The transaction closed after approval from the Brazilian antitrust authority. This acquisition aligns with Gerdau's capital allocation discipline and decarbonization strategy by expanding renewable energy self-production. The filing is a completion notice, not a new agreement, with no additional terms disclosed.
